stories.title: Lock Schema with TTL and Ownership Fields
stories.description: Define and implement the MongoDB schema for Brain locks including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and status. Configure TTL index to enable automatic expiration.

stories.title: Lock Acquisition and Renewal API
stories.description: Implement backend service methods for acquiring, renewing, and releasing locks with strict ownership validation and TTL extension logic.

stories.title: Lock Conflict Detection and Response Handling
stories.description: Implement logic to detect lock contention scenarios and return deterministic responses (e.g., lock denied, retry-after) for competing Brain processes.

stories.title: Observability and Audit Logging for Lock Lifecycle
stories.description: Add structured logging for lock acquisition, renewal, expiration, recovery, and conflicts to support auditability and debugging.
